_comment: What the controls screen SAYS each action is for. The keys themselves are not
listed here on purpose -- ControlsOverlay reads them out of the live InputMap at
runtime, so a rebinding in project.godot cannot leave this file telling the
player something that is no longer true.
Rows appear in this order, grouped by 'group'. An action missing from the
InputMap is skipped rather than shown with a blank key. An optional 'through'
names a last action, and the row shows the range rather than only the first key.
